final_answer:
Meta's revenue grew significantly faster than Amazon's from FY2023 to FY2024.

- Meta Platforms: revenue rose from $134,902M (FY2023) to $164,501M (FY2024), a growth of ~21.94% [DOC: Meta Platforms 10-K FY2024, accession 0001326801-25-000017].
- Amazon: net sales rose from $574,785M (FY2023) to $637,959M (FY2024), a growth of ~10.99% [DOC: Amazon.com 10-K FY2024, accession 0001018724-25-000004].

Both figures represent total consolidated revenue/net sales on a comparable full fiscal-year basis (both companies report on a calendar fiscal year), so the comparison is directly comparable.

Meta's growth rate exceeded Amazon's by approximately 10.95 percentage points (21.94% − 10.99%).

ANSWER: Meta grew faster, by approximately 10.95 percentage points (Meta ~21.94% vs. Amazon ~10.99%).
